prompt:
Create one exact 2×2 pixel-art horizontal gaze atlas from the supplied reference. Canvas aspect ratio 128:70, four equal complete 64×35 upper-face crops, no gutters, borders, labels, or extra panel. Cell order: top-left LEFT OPEN; top-right RIGHT OPEN; bottom-left LEFT HALF; bottom-right RIGHT HALF.

Preserve this exact NPC075 angry source: newly selected angry brows locked in shape and position through native row 24, hair/fringe, forehead, bridge, eye spacing, eye-opening width and height, source colors, compact dark amber-brown iris/pupil pixel clusters, and native pixel-art style. Do not redesign the face, brows, eyelids, or aperture. Keep pupils dark and irises compact.

Only move gaze laterally by about ONE native pixel per eye, not two or more. In LEFT, move BOTH pupil/iris centers one native pixel toward the IMAGE LEFT edge from their centered source positions (target dark pupil near x21 in left eye and x40 in right eye). In RIGHT, move BOTH one native pixel toward the IMAGE RIGHT edge (near x23 and x42). Both eyes must visibly move in the same canvas direction. Do not leave one centered, reverse one eye, or move the pair toward each other. Keep source-like alignment and convergence.

Keep eye interiors as dark and muted as the source. Show only a small, shaded, low-contrast sclera patch where needed, never a pale cream/white horizontal stripe or broad bright band. Use no pure-white glint; keep any glint tiny and muted warm tan. Do not enlarge or round the irises, pupil, or eye opening.

The bottom pair must remain half-closed, using the selected narrow source aperture. Keep each iris at exactly the same horizontal position as its matching open gaze. Lower only the upper lid enough to cover the top of the iris. Keep at least one dark pupil pixel and part of the dark amber iris visible in each eye; do not cover or erase the entire pupil. Do not shift pupil sideways between OPEN and HALF. Keep lower lid at native row 28 and cheek pixels from row 29 onward fixed.

Preserve every pixel outside the existing eye masks, including hair, brows, forehead, bridge, and framing. Output only this exact 128×70 atlas with nearest-neighbor stepped pixel art and no blur or smoothing.
